t: Flomasta PipeGrip Elbow is a push-fit water pipe fitting designed for turning 15mm pipe through a smooth 90° bend. Featuring a dual locking system and green band indicator, it guarantees a secure, leak-free connection without tools or hot works. WRAS approved and compatible with copper or plastic pipe, these pipe elbows are ideal for routing pipework around corners in tight spaces.
b: Suitable for Hard & Soft Water Areas
